subject: Bug in PMEMD Plumed Compilation in Amber24

messages.author: Zihao Bai
messages.body:
Dear AMBER Developers,
In Amber24, PMEMD cannot be compiled with Plumed unless the NEED_plumed option is explicitly set in cmake.
The issue appears to be that plumed is missing from the 3RDPARTY_TOOLS variable in pmemd24_src/cmake/3rdPartyTools.cmake. This seems to be a bug introduced after the separation of SANDER and PMEMD in 2025.
Best regards,
Zihao
